content.text: Submitted. The proposal now inserts a single, minimal Section 5.4 after the final body paragraph of Section 5 (p0143): a Customer convenience right on 30 days' written notice, a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and an express bar on MSL convenience termination during the initial or any renewal term. The Purchase Order/Work scope expansion, the "no termination fee or penalty" phrase, and the dangling Sections 5.2/5.3 inventory cross-reference were removed, and the deterministic "Customer convenience termination present" check now passes.
